_about: 2001 census collection districts (CD_CODE_2001, ABS asgc2001.gpkg's Census_Collection_District_2001 layer) allocated whole to the divisions the 2001 federal election was fought on (the same gpkg's own Commonwealth_Electoral_Division_2001 layer — the exact polygons extract-asgc2001-ced.py renders the /map/ frame's n-2001.geojson from) by majority of a 6x6 grid sample — the seat-sum membership the 2001 election's measured census-people store pools its 2001 BCP counts over (derive-booth-demo-2001-frame.py). No ABS CD-2001 -> 2001-edition concordance exists; sibling of cd-2001-ced-2003ed.json's lane (the 2004 election's set). Island/spillover minorities outside every era polygon are legal only as the ABS 'Off-Shore Areas & Migratory' balance SLA (see offshoreClass) — people in them are division-less by ABS's own filing. Generated by derive-cd-2001-ced-2001set.py, machinery shared with derive-ced-era-alloc.py and derive-cd-2001-ced-alloc.py.
